invariants.rationale: The average number of bytes per record should always be positive, since record size estimates and thresholds are based on file/record sizes which should not be negative or zero.
If no valid recent commits are found, avgSize (and thus result) defaults to getCopyOnWriteRecordSizeEstimate(). Otherwise, it might be greater but not less.
The method will not set avgSize above Parquet small file limit, since record size estimation is designed to prevent exceeding file size limits.
The timeline is always used, so it cannot be null at this point.
Configuration must be non-null to access its properties; used throughout the method.
